The art has always been good, and getting better, but it's generally been SotM art. It's like a comic book that's had a very long run with the same creative team - Incredible with Kirkman, Walker, and  Oatley  for instance. Then we just got a sample of the same title or the the related title that was done in the 70s. I dont' know -- how about we've been reading Astonishing X-Men with Wheadon and Cassady, then we were given Giant Sized X-Men #1 (which introduced the "international X-Men" with Wolverine, Nightcrawler, etc.) from Len Wein and Dave Cockrum.

Christopher - Thanks Much!

I firmly believe in the "credit where credit is due," and I can tell a lot of love went in to this deck, in particular. I just hope Adam gets in here often enough to see it. This also makes me sad to realize that the Kickstarter for the Comic didn't go through. 

Yeah, a friend of mine and I were rolling on the floor when we spotted the Liefeld send-up on one of Guise's cards (don't have my cards with me, so I can't remember which one), all huge guns, tiny legs and heads, and monstrously over-sized torso and limbs...

Chris and Paul: Keep giving Adam fun ideas for his art! It seems to get better with every single expansion! :)
